messages.subject: Time recording — May narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hello,

Our records show unposted time for the period 1–28 May. Please ensure all narratives are entered and submitted by 17:00 on Monday 1 June so that the monthly bills can be raised. Matters with WIP over 30 days will be flagged to the supervising partner.

Note the new requirement for full activity narratives on all restructuring matters (no 'attendance — various').

Thank you,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
